title: US stocks today: Dow soars 600 pts, S&P, Nasdaq over 1% as Fed governor Waller's remarks ease rate hike fears
summary: US stocks rallied over 1% on Thursday as Fed Governor Christopher Waller's comments eased rate hike fears ahead of the US jobs report. The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones all gained, while Nvidia and software stocks rose. Broadcom fell after its revenue forecast failed to meet high AI expectations.

title: Former chief statistician Pronab Sen seeks two GDP series with old, new bases for five years
summary: Advocating for dual GDP series, former chief statistician Pronab Sen argues that accurate double deflation is contingent upon extensive data on input and output prices. Following India's introduction of a new GDP series, unease surrounding the growth figures and protocols for the back series has surfaced, leading to an expected release from the NSO by December 2026.

title: Gold jumps 2% as Fed Governor Waller's comments temper rate hike bets
summary: Gold prices jumped more than 2% as traders cut bets on a September US Fed rate hike after Governor Christopher Waller signalled support for keeping rates unchanged if inflation continues to cool. Lower Treasury yields and a weaker dollar further boosted bullion, while investors await US jobs and inflation data.

title: India, Belgium deepen defence, trade and critical minerals ties
summary: India and Belgium agreed to expand their partnership in defence and trade.  Cooperation in defence and security is a key pillar of their relationship.  Both nations will enhance military exchanges and training cooperation between them.  They also agreed to strengthen intelligence sharing and cooperation against crime.  Belgium conveyed solidarity with India in the fight against terrorism.

title: Fed's Waller says safety premium for Treasuries is gone, pushing neutral rate higher
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the loss of the traditional safety premium on US Treasuries is pushing the neutral interest rate higher, potentially keeping borrowing costs elevated. He also warned that the US cannot simply grow its way out of its $40 trillion debt burden without bringing structural deficits closer to zero.
